📉 What moved today, Tuesday 17 November

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 0.8% lower at 102,752, a third day of losses. Resource shares fell 1.5% and industrials 1.3%, while banks and insurers rose 0.3%. The fall came after a sharp drop on Wall Street overnight.

🛢️ Brent oil rose 1.5% to about $93.86 a barrel. Gold gained 0.6% to about $3,878.

💱 The rand held steady at about R16.93 to the dollar.

What it means for you: oil climbed back today, so the December petrol cut is not locked in yet.

Coming up: October inflation tomorrow, and the Reserve Bank's rate decision on Thursday.

Prices are 15-minute delayed. Education, not financial advice.
